classification_rules.PRESENTATION_CLARIFICATION: Meaning is preserved while its interface, explanation, or story-facing projection is made unambiguous.
classification_rules.PARAMETER_CHANGE: A numerical or categorical calibration value changes without changing its model family.
classification_rules.IMPLEMENTATION_CORRECTION: Executable behavior is brought back into agreement with an already-governing rule.
classification_rules.LOCAL_RULE_REPAIR: A bounded rule is added or narrowed to protect existing architecture and invariants.
classification_rules.SUBSYSTEM_REVISION: One subsystem contract changes and requires explicit downstream migration.
classification_rules.ARCHITECTURE_REOPENING: A protected cross-system invariant or model-family decision is reconsidered.

entries.title: Canonical semantic-origin entitlement key
entries.finding: Raw labels could distinguish claims derived from one underlying event.
entries.resolution: Entitlements are keyed by recipient, protected facet, and canonical causal origin before aliases are evaluated.

entries.title: Source-bounded renewal witness
entries.finding: The inherited generic recovery API accepted a provenance label without proving a replenishing input budget.
entries.resolution: Recovery and spawning require a typed source witness and cannot exceed the witnessed renewable input or remaining capacity.

entries.title: Projection, evidence, access, and authority separation
entries.finding: A truthful or forged interface record could be mistaken for the capability, permission, or fact displayed.
entries.resolution: Every consequential projection requires source evidence, audience permission, scope, and a distinct authority or capability witness.

entries.title: Exclusive identity-continuation ledger
entries.finding: Embodied, copied, summoned, or restored processes lacked one shared executable holder registry.
entries.resolution: One identity lineage may have at most one continuing holder; copies and successors receive explicit derived identities unless a witnessed exclusive transfer occurs.

entries.title: Stimulus-origin deduplication and harm gate
entries.finding: Separately submitted labels could multiply one physical or cognitive stimulus, and damage lacked a universal no-free-growth gate.
entries.resolution: Adaptation is bounded by unique causal stimulus origins, loaded structures, recovery, and headroom; damage cannot itself become positive adaptation.

entries.title: Replace the proposed protagonist Soul multiplier with a non-scalar profile
entries.finding: A single multiplier would collapse distinct Soul facets and falsely imply one universal power coefficient.
entries.resolution: No universal Soul multiplier exists. Reincarnate Continuity preserves identity; Embodied Integration and Soul Consolidation earn facet-specific development in Depth, Coherence, Resonance, boundary integrity, coupling, recovery, and safe assimilation.
